name: AstroGuru: Daily Plan
subtitle: Personal Growth & Daily Plan
promotionalText: Turn personalized insights into practical daily actions. Plan your day, reflect on decisions, journal your dreams, and build meaningful personal routines.
description:
AstroGuru turns personalized insights into practical actions for everyday life.

Plan your day, reflect on important decisions, keep meaningful journals, build personal routines, and explore the astrological context behind your experiences — all in one personalized journey.

YOUR PERSONAL DAILY PLAN

Start each day with personalized recommendations and practical actions. Review your daily focus, complete supported actions, and share feedback that helps keep future plans relevant.

COSMIC PLANNER

Explore upcoming days by date and category. Review timing insights and create local reminders for activities you choose.

DECISION COMPASS

Explore work, relationships, communication, wellbeing, and other real-life categories through structured perspectives that support your own reflection. Decision Compass does not make decisions for you.

DREAM JOURNAL

Record dreams, revisit previous entries, explore symbols and themes, and optionally receive personalized interpretations.

PERSONAL PRACTICES

Use meditation and breathing sessions, prayers, Esma and Surah content, counters, saved practice progress, and a personal practice journal.

RELATIONSHIPS

Explore compatibility across supported contexts such as love, friendship, family, work, and rivalry. Review several relationship dimensions instead of a single generic result.

ASTROLOGICAL CONTEXT

Astrology remains an important part of AstroGuru. Explore your natal chart, daily and weekly horoscope information, current transits, compatibility, numerology, and other personalized content. AstroGuru connects these insights with planning, reflection, journaling, and everyday actions instead of presenting only static reports.

YOUR JOURNEY, YOUR CHOICES

AstroGuru is designed for reflection, entertainment, and personal exploration. Astrological and AI-generated insights are not guarantees or predictions of future outcomes and do not replace professional medical, financial, legal, psychological, or other advice.
